title: South Dakota Codified Laws Chapter 43-32 - Lease of Real Property
verified_how: fetched the Title index https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/43: CatchLine 'PROPERTY', chapter row '32 Lease Of Real Property' with no [Repealed] marker (siblings 43-10, 43-15, 43-38 and 43-41A do carry it); then fetched https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/43-32: Type 'Chapter', CatchLine 'LEASE OF REAL PROPERTY', Repealed false, sections running from 43-32-1. Currency: code effective date 2026-09-03.
notes: South Dakota has not enacted the Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act; residential tenancy (security deposits, habitability, notice to quit, landlord entry) is carried inside this general leasing chapter. Eviction procedure is SDCL ch. 21-16 (Forcible Entry and Detainer). General consumer protection is a different statute, SDCL ch. 37-24 (Deceptive Trade Practices and Consumer Protection), verified in force on https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/Statute/37 but not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
